note: The first ZVON room: the small measuring room inside the invented pump hut on the Sursky kanal (S38), June 1960 (type references: 1935 physics room, 1960 laboratory bench). Frontal camera ~1.7 m high facing the back wall: horizon y 470, perspective s(y) = (y - 470) / 545 (hero 1.7 m = 512 px at y 1015; ~138 px per metre at the back wall, foot y 720). A long laboratory table stands along the back wall (top y 610, legs to y ~748); on it, in the middle, the table mechanical resonator (brass rods on a heavy wooden base) with the brass calibration plate fixed upright on its front, the green desk lamp at its left end and Mira's open notebook at its right. Above: a blackboard with invented symbols, an instrument panel, two globe lamps; a small window shows the canal. The v1 painting shows the short side walls: the open plank door back to the canal bank is on the left side wall, the narrow door to the archive loft on the right side wall. Mira stands at the right end of the table. The walk polygon is the plank floor in front of the table, bounded by the foot lines of the side walls.
